allOf.description: intent.accept is the only transition to protected status (plan §5.4); an accepted record must carry its acceptance record.

description: Registry status of an Intent Contract: Proposed vs accepted, the acceptance audit record, and the §4.2.1 signature chain honored on bundle import.

chain.description: Signature chain for §4.2.1 intent-bundle import; an imported acceptance is honored only if this chain satisfies the local policy.

schema_id.description: Artifact-class identity of the governing schema: its `$id` with the `v<schema_epoch>/` segment removed (schemas/README.md). Stable across schema epochs.

schema_epoch.description: Schema epoch this instance was written against (schemas/README.md). It advances only on a breaking change to this artifact class, is not one of the six independently versioned epochs (RFC 0026 `rule versioning.epoch_independence`), and pins no semantics.

status.description: Import never changes protection status: an imported Proposed contract stays proposed (plan §4.2.1).

title: Intent Registry Record
